user.title: Add a BlinkyBeacon
user.description: Enter the address of the PC running blinkybeacon-tray. In the tray's settings, the bind address must be 0.0.0.0 or this PC's LAN address, not 127.0.0.1.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC the beacon is plugged into.
data_description.port: The tray's HTTP port, 1337 unless you changed it.
data_description.name: What to call this beacon, for example Home beacon.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC the beacon is plugged into.
data_description.port: The tray's HTTP port, 1337 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: The tray did not answer. Check that it is running, listens on a LAN address and that the PC's firewall allows the port.
error.invalid_reply: Something answered on that address, but it is not blinkybeacon-tray.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address, optionally with :port, without a path.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The beacon now uses the new address.
